content: Anti-VEGF therapy has become the standard of care for managing proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR) and diabetic macular edema. This treatment approach has demonstrated superior long-term visual outcomes compared to other methods. However, despite its effectiveness, anti-VEGF therapy often necessitates multiple intravitreal injections over time. Additionally, in certain cases, adjunctive laser therapy may still be required to achieve optimal disease control.
